description: Context-based assignments for standalone VICTORIA DOCK records
methodology: Proximity analysis (±5 lines) + origin port heuristics
notes: Records near Millwall, Tilbury, Royal Albert, Regent's docks → London
Baltic/Scandinavian origins (Riga, Danzig, Kronstadt, etc.) → Hull
North American origins (Boston, Halifax, Montreal) → London
Hull was the larger timber Victoria Dock, used as default
